read.title: Meditations
read.author: Marcus Aurelius
read.review:
Choose what is best. Best is what benefits me.
Choose not to be harmed and you won't feel harmed.
The mind is the ruler of the soul.
No pointless/aimless actions.
Everything is here for a purpose.

read.title: Psycho-Cybernetics
read.author: Maxwell Maltz
read.review:
Mental practice helps to make perfect. 90% is in the mental, 10% in the physical.
Your emotional state is dependent on your own response and reaction. Be an actor, not a reactor.
Feel like a winner and you'll win.

read.title: Mastery
read.author: Robert Greene
read.review:
The ultimate power is that everyone holds their fortune in their own hands.
Pour all your energy into your Life's Task
observe like a hunter in the wild, practice and become exceptional in the fundamentals, actively experiment, apply the knowledge to other fields

read.title: Atomic Habits
read.author: James Clear
read.review:
very cool, going to implement it in my life
make it obvious: change your environment, be aware
make it attractive: netflix and treadmill, you get to do something, not you have to do something
make it easy: frequency > time put in, two-minute rule (read becomes open the book, run a mile becomes put on shoes)
make it satisfying: instant gratification always wins (money you saved gets thrown into a savings account for cool jacket)
